The geographical areas that Omega Engineering currently provides engineering services for includes western Canada (Saskatchewan west), the province of British Columbia including northern BC, and the Yukon Territory.

Omega Engineering’s scope of services includes the following areas:

Civil Engineering
• Land development for commercial, industrial, and institutional projects
• Land development and utility design for large scale residential subdivisions
• Site grading and Erosion and Sediment Control
• Roadworks, streetscapes, parking facilities, community parks
• Storm sewer system analysis and design
• Storm water retention structures and groundwater infiltration systems
• Sanitary sewer system analysis and design / Pumping facilities
• Water mains, PRVs, Reservoirs, Water system network modeling and analysis
• Project management, surveying and construction field reviews
• Coordination with stakeholders, utilities and affected bodies.

Structural Engineering
• Structural analysis and design of commercial, industrial, institutional and agricultural buildings and structures.
• Structural design of multifamily residential buildings including apartments, condos, and townhouses
• Structural design of custom homes.
• Structural design of municipal infrastructure, pump stations, culverts, retaining walls, and pedestrian bridges
• Seismic assessment and upgrade design to existing buildings
• Inspection of pre-engineered steel building erection
• Inspection and certification of construction works

Omega Engineering provides complete engineering design utilizing design software for the analysis, modelling and design of the engineering works. We pride ourselves on the awareness of our team to provide relevant, efficient and constructible design solutions for our clients. Omega & Associates Engineering strives to provide a high quality product that meets the clients’ schedules and cost expectations, and can be relied upon for accuracy, constructability and completeness. Omega Engineering has an Organizational Quality Management system in place that has been certified by the Engineers and Geoscientists of BC. for the management of the company operations and implementation of quality assurance procedures. These initiatives have distinguished Omega Engineering in our business communities and we have been recipients of awards for the TOP BUSINESS of the Year 2013, Nominated TOP BUSINESS of the Year 2014, TOP 10 for BC BUSINESSES of the Year 2014 and Best Master Planned Development.- for the Garrison Crossing development in Chilliwack. Omega has also just been nominated for EFFECTIVE HUMAN RESOURCES STRATEGIES by the Fraser Valley Cultural Diversity Awards in recognition of their diverse and cultural organization and the strategies in place in the Human Resources department.

Omega & Associates Engineering also believes in supporting the communities that we work in. We are involved with local charities including Chilliwack Community Services, Chilliwack School of Performing Arts, Chilliwack Salvation Army, Rotary Leaders of Tomorrow, local schools and work experience programs, and also international charities including Compassion Canada, Free the Children and Mercy Ships.
